title: Enum Variant Privacy
goal: Expose enum variants correctly across module boundaries.
hints: Enum variants inherit the visibility of their enum.
Adding visibility qualifiers like pub directly to an enum variant is a syntax error.
explanation: Enum variants do not accept visibility qualifiers like `pub`. Making the `State` enum `pub` automatically exposes all of its variants and their contained values. Adding `pub` to individual variants causes a syntax error.
